name: io.github.trentleslie/biomapper
title: BioMapper
description: Resolve metabolite, lipid, protein, gene and lab names to knowledge-graph IDs.

environmentVariables.name: BIOMAPPER_MCP_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders map_file may read and write, path-separated (needed when the client shares no roots)

environmentVariables.name: BIOMAPPER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional API key; the hosted deployment is keyless

environmentVariables.name: BIOMAPPER_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the API root (staging or a local engine)
